comment: mklev.c fill_ordinary_room() -> mktrap() -> trap.c maketrap() -> mk_trap_statue(): the donor monster of a random statue trap is a doppelganger, a shapechanger, so makemon()'s first newcham() asks mon.c wiz_force_cham_form()'s "Change the doppelganger @ <x,y> into what?" under the wizard-mode monpolycontrol option, and C fills the rest of the room after the answer (ESC). A debug-mode Valkyrie level-teleports to dlvl 9 and rebuilds it with #wizmakemap; the fourth rebuild makes the trap. The seed came from a JavaScript search over seeds 5320000-5320059 for this site; the date, character and inputs were chosen independently.
